description: 5-step plain-text sequence (no link in step 1), CASL footer, reply buckets with not_now→60d re-sequence, positive-reply metric, new DFY mailboxes wired, signal-triggered send when a followed streamer spikes. Builds on lib/integrations/instantly, lib/admin/email, lib/admin/ai, create-sequence route. Read docs/wiki/plans/cold-email-v1.md first.

context.postal_footer: Viral Animal Inc. · 1685 rue Florence, Saint-Cyrille-de-Wendover, QC J1Z 0A6, Canada
context.sending_rules: 12/day/box (max 20), weekdays 8h-16h lead timezone, open tracking OFF everywhere, click tracking OFF step 1, warm-up score <70% → pause box, bounce >1.5% → pause campaign
context.do_not: No HTML, no images, no attachments, no link or Calendly in step 1, no 'limited time/exclusive/act now', no ALL CAPS, no exclamation marks, <80 words per email, never send from viralanimal.com

stories.title: Migration: sequence v2 columns + suppression reason + not_now bucket
acceptance: supabase/migrations/YYYYMMDDHHmmss_cold_email_v2.sql created AND applied via Supabase MCP apply_migration BEFORE any code
email_templates: add spintax_enabled boolean default false, max_words int default 80
influencers: add reply_bucket text check in (interested, evaluating, not_now, wrong_person, unsubscribed, negative) null, resequence_after date null
email_campaigns: add total_positive_replies int default 0, positive_reply_rate_pct numeric null
mailboxes: add warmup_score int null, warmup_paused_at timestamptz null
Verified with execute_sql on information_schema.columns for all 4 tables

stories.title: Seed 5-step sequence cold-v2 in email_templates (plain text, spintax, no link step 1)
acceptance: 5 rows sequence_id='cold-v2', step_number 1..5, delay_days 0,3,7,12,20
Step 1: <80 words, zero URLs, question of relevance + who we are + soft CTA (reply 'yes'), spintax {a|b|c} on greeting and CTA line
Step 2: social proof / what output looks like, still no link — offer to send the clip on reply
Step 3: the demo link {{demoVideoUrl}} allowed (first and only link before reply), <80 words
Step 4: give-to-receive — 'I already cut one clip from {{recentVideoTitle}}, want it?' no link
Step 5: breakup, offers 'not now' explicitly → sets bucket not_now
Every body_text ends with the CASL footer from context.postal_footer + {{unsubscribeLink}} + reply 'stop'
Seed is in the migration SQL (INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING), not via MCP, so it is reproducible
Word count check: every step body (excluding footer) ≤ 80 words

stories.title: create-sequence route: v2 rules (tracking, schedule, daily limits)
acceptance: POST /api/admin/campaigns/create-sequence with sequenceId='cold-v2' builds 5 steps
trackOpens=false on every step; trackClicks=false on steps 1,2,4,5 and true on step 3 only
Campaign schedule: Mon-Fri, 08:00-16:00 in lead timezone (fallback America/Toronto)
daily_limit per account = 12, stop_on_reply=true, stop_on_auto_reply=false
Request body validated with a zod schema in lib/schemas/cold-email.ts (sequenceId, emailAccountIds[], campaignName)
Refuses (400) if any emailAccountId belongs to a mailbox with domain viralanimal.com or a Zoho provider

stories.title: Sync the 8 DFY mailboxes into mailboxes table with sending rules
acceptance: syncMailboxes() upserts by email, sets provider='google', daily_send_limit=12, status from Instantly, instantly_account_id filled
Zoho mailboxes (domain in viralanimal.online/.site/.space/.store) get status='reception_only', daily_send_limit=0 — never selectable for campaigns
warmup_score pulled from Instantly warmup analytics; if <70 → pauseEmailAccount() + warmup_paused_at set + Discord alert
Admin /admin/mailboxes shows warmup score column and a 'reception only' badge

stories.title: Reply buckets: classifier → reply_bucket, not_now → resequence_after +60d
acceptance: reply-classifier intent mapped to reply_bucket: interested | evaluating | not_now | wrong_person | unsubscribed | negative
not_now → influencers.resequence_after = now()+60 days, status='dormant', removed from active Instantly campaign
wrong_person → status='declined', note stores any forwarded name/email from the reply for manual follow-up (no auto-send)
unsubscribed/'stop' → suppression list 4-way + Instantly unsubscribe, within the same request
interested → existing autoOnboard() unchanged; evaluating → Discord ping for manual reply
Inbound webhook body validated with zod (lib/schemas/cold-email.ts); the duplicate /api/admin/webhooks/instantly route is deleted and docs updated
stories.verify: npx tsc --noEmit && grep -n 'resequence_after' lib/admin/webhooks/instantly-processor.ts && test ! -e app/api/admin/webhooks/instantly/route.ts && echo DUP_ROUTE_REMOVED

stories.title: Re-sequence cron: not_now leads back to cold after 60 days
acceptance: app/api/cron/resequence-leads/route.ts, protected by CRON_SECRET via timingSafeCompare, daily
Selects influencers where reply_bucket='not_now' and resequence_after <= today and not suppressed (4-way) → status='cold', reply_bucket=null, tag 'resequenced'
Never re-adds anyone with unsubscribed=true or has_bounced=true
Returns { data: { resequenced: n }, error: null }
Cron registered in netlify.toml (or wherever other crons are declared — check publish-scheduled)

stories.title: Positive-reply rate as the primary metric (opens ignored)
acceptance: syncCampaigns() computes total_positive_replies = count of email_messages inbound with reply_bucket in (interested, evaluating) per campaign
positive_reply_rate_pct = positive / total_sent * 100
Admin /admin/campaigns list shows Positive reply % as first metric; open rate column removed or greyed with tooltip 'unreliable in 2026'
Health guard: if bounce_rate > 1.5% on a campaign → pause campaign via Instantly + Discord alert

stories.title: Compliance preflight v2 blocks bad sequences before Instantly
acceptance: lib/admin/offer-generator/compliance-preflight.ts extended: step 1 contains a URL → fail; any step > 80 words (excluding footer) → fail; footer missing postal address or {{unsubscribeLink}} → fail; banned phrases (limited time, exclusive, act now, !!!, ALL-CAPS words >3) → fail
create-sequence route runs preflight and returns 422 with the list of violations
Unit-style check script scripts/check-sequence.ts <sequenceId> prints PASS/FAIL per step
stories.verify: npx tsc --noEmit && npx tsx scripts/check-sequence.ts cold-v2 | grep -c PASS | xargs test 5 -eq && echo PREFLIGHT_5_PASS

stories.title: Signal-triggered outbound: streamer spike → lead promoted with fresh clip variables
acceptance: New lib/outreach/spike-trigger.ts: given a streamer (twitch/kick login), find matching influencer by platform_handle; if found and status in (cold, queued) and not suppressed → set tag 'spike', next_follow_up_at=now(), recent_video_titles refreshed from the spiking clip title, ai_specific_compliment regenerated

Hook point: where trending/velocity detection already runs (lib/scoring/account-scorer.ts or fetch-twitch-clips cron) — call spike-trigger when velocity crosses the existing 'viral' threshold; no new scraping
Leads tagged 'spike' in the last 24h are exported first by csv-generator / pushOffersToInstantly (priority order)
If a render of the spiking clip exists (render_jobs done, TRANSFORM SCORE 3/3), its public URL is stored in influencers.notes JSON as demo_clip_url for use in step 3/4
No email is sent by this story — it only prioritizes and enriches; sending stays in Instantly with the 12/day cap
stories.verify: npx tsc --noEmit && grep -n 'spike' lib/outreach/spike-trigger.ts && grep -rn 'spike-trigger' lib app | grep -v spike-trigger.ts | head -1

stories.title: Manual-first path: /admin/inbox 'send demo + affiliate link' one-click for interested leads
acceptance: On an influencer with reply_bucket='interested', admin inbox shows a button 'Send demo kit' that drafts (not sends) a reply containing: demo_clip_url if present else niche demo, the affiliate code (existing autoOnboard), and the 5-clips-free offer restated
Draft uses lib/admin/ai/reply-drafter with the founder tone from docs/about/founder.md (short, direct, French or English matching the lead's language)
Sending is a second explicit click; nothing auto-sends
Event logged in email_messages direction=outbound with template_id null and campaign_id of origin
stories.verify: npx tsc --noEmit && grep -rn 'Send demo kit' app/\(dashboard\)/admin/inbox | head -1
